segments.normalizedSource: The following example shows a prolog that saves key registers, including several VFP registers.
segments.contextBefore: Specifically, Thumb is capable of saving and restoring the contents of the VFP registers, and ARMv7 assembly uses a unified set of mnemonics.
segments.contextAfter: It also allocates 36 bytes for local storage.

segments.source: It also allocates 36 bytes for local storage.
segments.normalizedSource: It also allocates 36 bytes for local storage.
segments.contextBefore: The following example shows a prolog that saves key registers, including several VFP registers.
segments.contextAfter:
```other
push add  {r4-r7, lr}     // save LR, R7, R4-R6.
add       r7, sp, #12     // Adjust R7 to point to saved R7.
push      {r8, r10, r11}  // Save remaining GPRs (R8, R10, R11).
vstmdb    sp!, {d8-d15}   // Save VFP/Advanced SIMD registers D8 
                          // (aka S16-S31, Q4-Q7).
sub       sp, sp, #36     // Allocate space for local storage.
```

segments.contextAfter:
```other
add       sp, sp, #36     // Deallocate space for local storage.
vldmia    sp!, {d8-d15}   // Restore VFP/Advanced SIMD registers.
pop       {r8, r10, r11}  // Restore R8-R11.
pop       {r4-r7, pc}     // Restore R4-R6, saved R7, and 
                          // return to saved LR
```
